Header.title: Address Book 1854

WelcomeModal.title: Welcome to the Address Book 1854
WelcomeModal.body1: This is a hobby project by <name>Lieuwe Jongsma</name> (Groninger Archieven). The goal is to make the Groningen address book or name register of 1854 searchable and to put it on the map.
WelcomeModal.disclaimer: Note: this is a work in progress. The book uses the old ward numbering (ward letter and number). The conversion to present-day addresses may contain errors or gaps; about a quarter of the entries is not on the map yet.

map.title: The map
map.text: This is the map of present-day Groningen. The highlighted buildings stand on the site of an address from the 1854 address book. Click a building to see who had their business there.

layers.title: Map layers
layers.text: Switch the highlighted address buildings on or off here.

scan.title: Page view
scan.text: View the original scanned page from the 1854 address book. Browse the book and zoom in on the details.

section.title: Sections
section.text: Jump to the parts of the book: the register by occupation and the alphabetical name list at the back.
